findings.heading: audit repair mechanism
findings.evidence: The live 100-turn session has zero occurrences of `enriched 2026-10-09T04:16:29Z`; the retained 04:15:49Z stamp appears 138 times, matching 46 records in three sections. For each of the 17 turns, counts are original summaries plus one full record per summary, with matching decision dialog and action counts. Turn `59ce` still holds both verdicts: five ordered round-1 parts concatenate ordinally to the 17,331-character round-1 Markdown receipt, and four round-2 parts to the 11,653-character round-2 receipt. Source `SessionLogService.cs:1904` assigns dialog ordinals per batch; `:1240-1274` removes all matching items. The transcript and iterate-hv action 3 disclose duplicate enrichment and use of `DeleteTurnItemAsync` plus `ReplaceTurnSectionAsync`. No unrelated loss is evidenced by the available counts and exact HV comparison, but a complete pre-rewrite snapshot was not available. Replacing two sections and deleting actions in an audit record violates the profile's append-only decision instruction and removes evidence of the duplicate from those sections. **Incurable historically:** preserve the incident and before/after evidence in a separate correction record; future repairs should append corrections without overwriting audit sections.

The replacements cover protocol and receipts, transitions, P0.9, FR-MCP-SESSIONREVIEW-005-AC003, UC-7, A9, S8, and S11. No operative PR-comment HV direction remains.
